# NOTES — OB-BAA standard adapter YANG library (capability lists)

- Source repo: https://github.com/BroadbandForum/obbaa-yang-modules (branch master)
- License: BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2018-2021 Broadband Forum (see LICENSE here)
- Download date: 2026-07-02
- What: real-format NETCONF `<rpc-reply>` documents carrying
  `ietf-yang-library` `modules-state` — i.e. the complete YANG module capability
  list a standard bbf-xpon OLT/ONU reports. Useful to validate capability/yang-library
  parsing for BBF-standard OLTs (Adtran SDX in standards mode advertises a superset
  of this shape). bbf-olt-standard-2.1 lists 29 bbf-xpon* modules.
